review.tagline: Spec and Elixir reference for agents that pick up Linear tasks and open PRs
review.summary: Symphony watches a Linear board for work and spawns isolated agent runs for each task. Agents report proof of work such as CI status, PR review feedback, complexity analysis and walkthrough videos, and land the PR once accepted. The repo ships a language-agnostic SPEC.md and an experimental Elixir reference implementation.
review.audience: Teams wanting to delegate tracked tickets to coding agents
strengths: Language-agnostic SPEC.md lets you implement it in any language
Each task runs as an isolated, autonomous implementation run
Agents attach proof of work: CI status, review feedback, walkthrough videos
Apache-2.0 licensed reference implementation in Elixir
weaknesses: Described as a low-key engineering preview for trusted environments only
Expects codebases that have already adopted harness engineering
RAM, ports and model support are not stated in the main README
